R0103.title: Spectator Wallhack
R0103.definition: A player uses a wallhack cheat on a secondary account to spectate their main account, typically found in FPS games.
R0103.description: The basic principle involves using two accounts: a main account and a secondary account used for spectating. After the main and secondary accounts become friends, the main account enters the game while the secondary account opens a wallhack to spectate the main account. Through the secondary account's wallhack, the main account can easily track enemy positions and gain an unfair advantage. If the secondary account is banned, the player creates a new one and continues.
R0103.influence: This behavior undermines game fairness and seriously impacts other players' experience.

observables: The same player's main and secondary accounts appear in the same match, with the secondary account in spectator mode
The secondary account's spectator view lingers on enemy positions and calls out locations
The main account's pre-aim and movement align abnormally well with the secondary account's spectator intel
After the secondary account is banned, a new secondary account is quickly created to continue spectating the same main account
The main and secondary accounts are friends and appear in the same match, with the secondary account only spectating and not participating
